database.stem: The ------- tough training given by our company creates strong and able sales representatives who perform well above others in the same field.
database.raw_text:
The ------- tough training given by our company creates strong and able sales
representatives who perform well above others in the same field.
(A) indifferently
(B) presumably
(C) completely
(D) unbearably
database.explanation:
本题需选择可与tough搭配的副词。tough training(高强度
培训)令人难以忍受，故(D)unbearably(难以忍受地)符合题意。
